'''''Plo's Bros''''' was the designation given to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] used by the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:PlosBrosLogo-HH.jpg|thumb|left|150px|''Plo's Bros'' nose art]]
The gunships were decorated with customized nose art depicting the face of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] between two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] underneath the words "Plo's Bros" written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]. The ships were also painted blue in areas that stock LAAT/i gunships were maroon in color.<ref name="R2CH">{{TCW|R2 Come Home}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|First Battle of Felucia]], Republic forces under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] were engaged in battle with the forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. They were being overwhelmed by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] and without support due to a Separatist blockade around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] was dispatched to bring break the blockade and evacuate the surviving Republic forces.<ref name="Holocron Heist">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref>

As Koon's ships engaged the Separatist blockade force in orbit, several starfighters and gunships managed to reach the surface. They first evacuated Kenobi and Skywalker team, the two generals boarding ''Plo's Bros''. They then proceeded to where Commander Tano's team appeared to be driving the droid army back, though they were actually drawing Tano's troops into a trap. It was a ruse that fooled the young commander, who even refused to obey a direct order from General Kenobi to withdraw. Skywalker commanded the pilot to land ''Plo's Bros'' and the other gunships between Tano's [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernaut]] and the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] forcing the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] to cease firing and evacuate her [[Clone trooper/Legends|troops]]. As ''Plo's Bros'' and the other gunships lifted into the sky, Tano watched the Juggernaut she had just vacated destroyed by overwhelming enemy fire.<ref name="Holocron Heist" />

<div style="float:right">[[File:FeluciaMorningAfter2-PL.png|thumb|left|250px|''Plo's Bros'' gunships collect Republic troops following the [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|Second Battle of Felucia]].]]</div>
Some time later, a trio of ''Plo's Bros'' gunships assisted in the [[Mission to Vanqor/Legends|rescue]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] who had become trapped on the bridge of the wreckage of [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']], a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] that had crashed on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor's]] surface.<ref name="R2CH" />

[[Space gunship/Legends|One]] was used in a rescue from the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]], passing through the blockade over the planet with the help of three Delta 7B starfighters.<ref name="CR">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref> This gunship had its bubble turrets replaced with two large external floodlights, and had a sealed cabin.<ref name="EGCR">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode320.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Citadel Rescue}}</ref>
